localSetup.heroDesc: Run the ANT backend and IDE servers locally to work with your local codebase while using this cloud-hosted frontend.
localSetup.directAccessDesc: Work with your local codebase directly
localSetup.preferredIdeDesc: Open files in Cursor, VS Code, or any local editor
localSetup.fullPrivacyDesc: All AI processing and data stays on your machine
localSetup.noAuthDesc: Skip sign-up and start coding immediately
localSetup.cloudFrontendDesc: Use this optimized UI without local setup
localSetup.cloneRepoDesc: Clone the ANT Works repository from GitHub to your local machine.
localSetup.installDepsDesc: Install all required packages using pnpm (Node.js v22+ required).
localSetup.pnpmNote: If you don't have pnpm, install it with:
localSetup.configEnvDesc: Copy the example config and set up your API keys.
localSetup.localCloudNote: Local and Cloud servers use the same infrastructure (Redis + Preview Worker). Only authentication differs.
localSetup.startServicesDesc: Launch required services. Each command should run in a separate terminal.
localSetup.redisDesc: Redis is used for state management and job queue.
localSetup.workerDesc: Processes AI jobs from the queue.
localSetup.connectDesc: Once your local servers are running, switch to Local mode in the navigation bar at the top.
localSetup.step1Connect: Click the "Local" button in the top navigation bar
localSetup.step2Connect: The page will automatically connect to your local backend
localSetup.step3Connect: Start working with your local codebase!
